findings: The Skillsta Drawing funnel asks for a verification code right after the email. Of the competitors captured, only Copymind does this; Breeze, Simply Piano, MemoryOS and SmartyMe go straight from email to the plan and paywall.
The weakest Drawing step is Loader → Email: only 12% of users who reach the loader submit an email, and only 22% of those then reach the paywall.
SmartyMe has the most active ads among drawing competitors (~2,170 across its pages, 124 started in the window). Its web ads still land on the generic small-talk quiz, not a drawing quiz.
Simply Draw is inactive on Meta (6 ads, none new) and its funnel is 2 screens to a free-account gate; it competes on brand, not funnel.

Of the 9 competitor paywalls captured, most show a discount (50–63% off at Simply Piano, MemoryOS, Chillio, Learna, SmartyMe, Simply Draw) and 6 run a countdown timer; Breeze, MemoryOS, Copymind and SmartyMe add a money-back guarantee.
Paywalls not captured this run: Skillsta (email code), Imprint and Yousician (need an account), Simply Sing (walk stops at the voice question).
comparison_notes: The Skillsta Drawing funnel asks about 27 questions with 6 value or social-proof screens before the email gate. That's the most question-heavy funnel here; SmartyMe has 24 with 16 and MemoryOS 19 with 10.
The email screen asks “to get your personal plan”; Breeze and the Skillsta Vocal Scanner say “Your results are ready”.
Skillsta's drawing paywall wasn't captured because it sits behind the email code.

hypotheses.title: Turn the email gate into “your drawing results are ready”
hypotheses.seen_in: Skillsta Vocal Scanner (2× the loader → email rate), Breeze “Explore results”
hypotheses.change: Show a ready-made result (drawing level, style match, first lesson preview), blurred, and ask for email to unlock it
hypotheses.impact: Estimate: meaningful lift, Scanner shows the pattern works in Skillsta

hypotheses.title: Show the plan and paywall before email verification
hypotheses.seen_in: Breeze, Simply Piano, MemoryOS, SmartyMe: email → paywall with no code
hypotheses.change: Test moving the code step after the paywall or after purchase; first confirm with Amplitude where the 78% go after email_submit
hypotheses.impact: Estimate: largest lever if the code step causes the drop

hypotheses.title: Cut questions and add value screens that react to answers
hypotheses.seen_in: MemoryOS (reassurance after each answer), SmartyMe (16 value screens)
hypotheses.change: Drop 5–6 low-signal questions; add short screens that reflect the user's goal (e.g. “Portraits take 3 weeks to click”)
hypotheses.impact: Estimate: a few points of quiz completion

hypotheses.title: Add timer, discount and money-back guarantee if missing
hypotheses.seen_in: SmartyMe (60% off, 10-min timer, 28-day money-back), MemoryOS (63% off)
hypotheses.change: Audit the current drawing paywall against these patterns
